note: Golden examples for the Style Guide (docs/STYLE.md, 'Golden examples'). The player character is in the style the owner chose on 2026-10-23 (style N, docs/DESIGN.md). The others are the best placeholder art so far and are redrawn in that style over later milestones. The starter kit zip includes these files next to the palette and templates.
intro: The look: the wizard is style N; the rest is redrawn in it over time. Copy their approach, not their pixels.

examples.shows: A player character, style N: a narrow Stone robe with a Spark placket, belt and hem, two big tall eyes and no mouth, Skin hands, under a hat in the Player 1 ramp (the only player colour). The game draws the body strip and the hat as two pictures (content/wizard/base/); this is the two together
rules: player colour only on the hat

examples.shows: An enemy: Fire body, Bone horns and Spark eyes, no player colour, a bold silhouette
A raised tile: lit top and left edge, shaded bottom and right edge
A flat tile: Stone base, a few inner details, nothing on the outer edge so it repeats
A projectile: a streak in Bone materials with a Spark core, outlined in its own shadow shade
An impact: a flat burst in Spark materials, over in 0.2 s
